first_public_date_evidence: The publisher records publication of the motivating joint pattern-count paper by Chen and Cheng on 31/01/2000; no earlier exact public day is asserted for that work.
integrity: The six-vector is proved analytically by exact conditional probabilities and telescoping; exact finite permutation enumerations are independent checks but are not proofs for all sample sizes. No independent scientific audit is represented.
scientific_limitations: The result is for iid atomless observations and mixed first moments of six length-three consecutive pattern counts, not for dependent samples, higher moments or full distributions. A historical article on peak counts was accessible only via its primary abstract; implicit earlier coverage is possible.
title: Direction-resolved record–ordinal-pattern covariance in independent samples
